title: New 1904 walk: Women of Prairie Avenue
items: Six houses, 1608 to 2115 Prairie, each tied to a woman who mattered: Henrietta Frank (nursing education), Frances Glessner Lee (forensic science), Frances Glessner (her forty-year journal), Jane Grahame Jones (suffrage), Kate Buckingham (Buckingham Fountain) and Mrs. Philip D. Armour (the street's last great household).
Every fact is sourced on its stop; who was home on 1 July 1904 is not claimed.
